title: USB C Docking Station Dual Monitor Triple Display 4K Hdmi Displaylink Dock
writeup: This Giq 11-in-1 DisplayLink dock is meant for a one-cable desk, including on an M-series MacBook that normally cannot drive three external displays on its own. The listing says a DL-6950 chip can run up to three 4K@60 screens plus the laptop display, with 100W USB-C power-delivery pass-through, two USB 3.0 ports, and Gigabit Ethernet. It is $99.99. A wall charger is not included, and you have to install the DisplayLink driver before it will work.
